name: duopore-public-customer-revenue-concentration
description: See how much of your revenue comes from each customer, including your largest customers.

interface.longDescription: See how much of your revenue comes from each customer, including your largest customers. Share customer labels and revenue figures for one period and currency. Get each customer's share and the share from your top one and top three customers. This helps you see the mix in your figures. Refunds are not included, and the app does not predict business risk.
defaultPrompt: What share of my revenue comes from my biggest customers?
Group these revenue figures by customer label.

positive.prompt: Use Revenue Concentration with these explicitly supplied fictional inputs. Return the worksheet and limitations for my review: {"revenues":[{"recordId":"01","customer":"Alpha","amount":60},{"recordId":"02","customer":"Beta","amount":20},{"recordId":"03","customer":"Gamma","amount":20}]}
positive.expected_behavior: Use only these supplied inputs; no external verification, saving, sending or invented facts. Expected structured result: {"summary":"3 customers total 100.00 revenue; top customer share 60%.","rows":[{"rank":1,"customer":"Alpha","revenue":60,"sharePercent":60},{"rank":2,"customer":"Beta","revenue":20,"sharePercent":20},{"rank":3,"customer":"Gamma","revenue":20,"sharePercent":20},{"rank":0,"customer":"TOTAL / CONCENTRATION","revenue":100,"sharePercent":100,"topOnePercent":60,"topThreePercent":100,"concentrationIndex":4400}],"warnings":["One supplied period and currency; excludes refunds and future-risk prediction.","Zero total has undefined shares and concentration."]}
